article.title: On Jeffries’ Nomination for Speaker of the House
article.author: DSA National Statements
article.content: DSA stands with the members-elect who voted NO on Hakeem Jeffries’ nomination for Speaker of the House. On November 3rd, voters demanded a different kind of politics. They demanded bold steps towards medicare for all, abolishing ICE, and an end to Israel’s genocide in Gaza. They trusted Democrats with the responsibility of ending corporate control over politics. No more corporate coronations. Democrats who enable genocide, ICE, and billionaire interests must be ousted. Call your elected officials and demand they reject the establishment and adopt an agenda for the working class. The post On Jeffries’ Nomination for Speaker of the House appeared first on Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) .
